narrative.northStar: Every relationship. Back to its source.
narrative.overview:
The landing page makes the product's evidence-first promise visible: a source passage and a family or trust drawing share one stage, and selecting a claim reveals the exact supporting words. This is a focused public introduction to the synthetic example and practitioner prototype, not a description of all practitioner workflows.

The page carries Forest & Chalk into a distinct public surface. Public Sans gives its large offer and readable source fragment one clear voice. White source paper sits against a forest field; pale green connector lines and selected states stay legible there, while warm yellow marks exact Evidence. The landing voice differs from the practitioner application's system-font typography while retaining its established colors and product terminology.
keyCharacteristics: A direct, oversized offer with the action aligned beside it on wide screens.
A forest demonstration stage that joins exact source text to selectable relationship claims.
Quiet explanatory chapters that return to the source-to-claim-to-Evidence thread.
Professional acceptance remains a decision; the page describes synthetic material candidly.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Reserve warm yellow for the exact Evidence span; relationship selection uses pale green and a stronger connector instead.

rules.name: The Source Reading Rule
rules.body: Keep the quoted passage more prominent than its metadata, and use the Evidence color only on its exact supporting words.

rules.name: The Evidence Thread Rule
rules.body: Keep the source, relationship drawing, and selectable claims in one continuous demonstration region so a visitor can follow the evidence without changing contexts.

dos: Do keep exact Evidence visually distinct from relationship selection.
Do describe the example as curated synthetic material and preserve the explicit professional decision boundary.
Do make source, claim, and drawing content available without relying on the opening animation.
Do retain keyboard focus visibility and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't imply that the synthetic example is live analysis, measured customer output, or a professional judgment.
Don't use Evidence yellow as a general accent or selected-state color.
Don't carry the landing page's headline composition into the practitioner application's separate Working Atlas surface.
